I watched a baseball match from the edge of a bridge. After the pitch, a boy stretched his arm and made a great catch! Then, he slipped in a ditch and got a scratch. A dog ran to fetch the ball, but it got lodged in a hedge. The boy wiped the smudge from his pants. He won a badge at the end.
